top_choice_rationale: P002 honours a clean mechanism-then-discovery chain: the Bistritzer-MacDonald prediction that interlayer tunnelling flattens bands at a magic twist angle, and the 2018 observation of correlated insulators and superconductivity there. The citation is scoped to the flat-band prediction and the experimental discovery, so it does not depend on the unsettled pairing mechanism, and the idea has proved general across moire materials. I accept that the three-name limit leaves out Yuan Cao and that Bistritzer's share is the most contestable part, but I judge the science mature enough. P001 (optical lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) is a strong, well-attributed, well-reproduced second choice and far better than no award.
